scenes.context: 开场：流线型前伸 + 标题「蝶泳划手教学」。双手前伸呈流线型，身体拉平，准备开始划手动作。
sentences: 开场先做好流线型前伸。
Open with a streamlined forward extension.
streamlined（流线型）
双手前伸，身体拉平。
Arms stretched forward, body flat.
stretch（前伸）
scenes.speak: Open with a streamlined forward extension. Arms stretched forward, body flat.

scenes.title_cn: 划手四段：划手→抱水→推水→小拇指出…
scenes.title_en: Four Phases: Reach, Catch, Pull, Pinky-Out
scenes.context: 四段标签齐出：划手 → 抱水 → 推水 → 小拇指出水。蝶泳划水路径的完整四步，每一步都要做到位。
sentences: 蝶泳划手分四段：划手、抱水、推水、小拇指出水。
The butterfly pull has four phases: reach, catch, pull, pinky-first exit.
phase（阶段）
四步连贯，划水路径完整。
Four steps make a complete pull path.
complete path（完整路径）
scenes.speak: The butterfly pull has four phases: reach, catch, pull, pinky-first exit. Four steps make a complete pull path.

scenes.title_en: End of the Pull: Pinky Exits
scenes.context: 推水末端：小拇指侧出水，准备移臂。推水最后阶段向侧后推，小拇指先出水面，顺势移臂向前。
sentences: 推水末端，小拇指侧出水。
At the end of the pull, the pinky side exits the water.
pinky side（小拇指侧）
出水后顺势准备移臂。
Exit, then flow into the recovery.
flow into（顺势进入）
scenes.speak: At the end of the pull, the pinky side exits the water. Exit, then flow into the recovery.

scenes.title_cn: 入水关键：大拇指先入水
scenes.context: 入水关键点：大拇指先入水，双手重回前伸。移臂回前时大拇指领先切入水中，双手重新回到前伸的流线型。
sentences: 入水时大拇指先入水。
Enter the water thumbs first.
thumbs first（拇指先入）
双手重回前伸，回到流线型。
Hands return to the full forward extension.
return（回到）
scenes.speak: Enter the water thumbs first. Hands return to the full forward extension.

scenes.title_en: Body Cue: Chest Down, Hips Up
scenes.context: 身体提示：压胸（下）+ 提臀（上）配合手部推进。蝶泳不是光靠手臂，身体波浪配合压胸提臀，让推进更高效。
sentences: 压胸向下，配合手部推进。
Press the chest down to drive the pull.
press down（下压）
提臀向上，形成身体波浪。
Lift the hips up for the body wave.
body wave（身体波浪）
手和身体配合，推进更高效。
Hands and body together make the drive efficient.
drive（推进）
scenes.speak: Press the chest down to drive the pull. Lift the hips up for the body wave. Hands and body together make the drive efficient.

scenes.context: 路径复述：同一套黄字标签再次对齐虚线轨迹。反复确认划水路径，让肌肉记住正确的轨迹。
sentences: 黄字标签再次对齐虚线轨迹。
The same yellow labels align with the dashed trajectory.
trajectory（轨迹）
反复确认，让肌肉记住路径。
Repeat to burn the path into muscle memory.
muscle memory（肌肉记忆）
scenes.speak: The same yellow labels align with the dashed trajectory. Repeat to burn the path into muscle memory.

scenes.title_cn: 恢复阶段：指向拇指入水
scenes.title_en: Recovery: Aim for the Thumb Entry
scenes.context: 恢复阶段：移臂轨迹指向大拇指入水。空中移臂要低平放松，轨迹终点明确指向下一次的大拇指入水点。
sentences: 移臂轨迹指向大拇指入水点。
The recovery path aims at the thumb entry point.
aim（指向）
空中移臂低平放松。
Keep the aerial recovery low and relaxed.
aerial recovery（空中移臂）
scenes.speak: The recovery path aims at the thumb entry point. Keep the aerial recovery low and relaxed.

scenes.title_en: Wrap-Up: Body and Pull in Time
scenes.context: 收尾再强调身体：压胸 + 提臀与划手同拍。身体波浪和手臂划水必须严格同拍，这是蝶泳节奏的核心。
sentences: 压胸提臀要和划手同拍。
Chest press and hip lift must sync with the pull.
in time（同拍）
节奏对了，蝶泳才顺。
The right rhythm makes the butterfly flow.
flow（顺畅）
scenes.speak: Chest press and hip lift must sync with the pull. The right rhythm makes the butterfly flow.

practice: The pull has four phases: reach, catch, pull, pinky-out.
Press the chest down, lift the hips up.
Chest press and hip lift sync with the pull.
pitfalls: 小拇指先入水会阻水乱向
光靠手臂推水，蝶泳会很累
直臂移臂容易拉伤肩膀
四段划水跳步会丢推力
shifts: 现在压胸提臀用身体推进
现在大拇指先入水、双手回前伸
现在低平屈肘、指向拇指入水
footer_notes: 蝶泳划手四段：划手→抱水→推水→小拇指出水；入水拇指先行；身体压胸提臀与划手同拍。
